description: Permanently delete ONE catalog category by id. Its products are NOT deleted but lose this category (so they also drop out of marketplace feeds that require a category); its subcategories move to the top level; its translations and linked marketplace category ids are removed. NOT reversible. Not idempotent in effect: a second call for the same id returns NOT_FOUND. Call get_category first to read productCount and subcategoryCount, and confirm with the user before deleting a category that has products. The result reports productsUncategorized and subcategoriesMovedToRoot and echoes the operating workspace.

id.description: The category id returned by list_categories.

name: delete_category
title: Delete category
